name: transit
description: Live and scheduled transit for the DC region: WMATA Metrobus and Metrorail through WMATA's API and GTFS feeds, Montgomery County Ride On through its published GTFS and the live data behind RideOn.app, and a trip planner over all three.

provides_capabilities.title: WMATA API
provides_capabilities.summary: Live Metrobus and Metrorail arrivals, vehicle positions, alerts and detours, plus the static schedules the planner uses.
provides_capabilities.setup_hint: Default-tier key from developer.wmata.com; store it with herald secret request transit.wmata_api_key.

setup.prompt: A WMATA API key (free, default tier, from developer.wmata.com)
